py="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)" && "$py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tool/spry.py" agent-hook link_fields
py="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)" && "$py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tool/spry.py" agent-hook link_fields
py="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)" && "$py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tool/spry.py" agent-hook cited_criteria
py="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)" && "$py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tool/spry.py" agent-hook check_edit
py="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)" && "$py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tool/spry.py" agent-hook check_stop
